audited_criteria.interpretation: Known-task development calibration. In EACH fixed seed, all-task and common-success whole-job tokens must decrease with no full-mode success lost. Actual disclosure on a common success and intact contracts are required. Repetitions are not independent tasks; bytes, API savings and cheap failures do not establish the token goal.

cost_scope: All roles, failed work, control, recovery and checkpoint costs stay in the audited whole-job ledger.
time_scope: Work, program, lookup and control durations overlap; server time includes cells and evaluation. Do not add these measures.
byte_scope: Control bytes are interpreter-host traffic, not model input tokens.
